profile.name: 单路数据流工具
profile.description: 用于实验中打开数据文件、记录时间区间并运行单路数据流处理的非实体软件组件。它更像是实验数据采集或流式记录辅助程序，而不是直接控制物理仪器的设备。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component used in experiments to open data files, record time intervals, and run single-stream data handling. It appears to be a helper for data acquisition or streaming/logging rather than direct control of a physical instrument.
